subject: Motor Vehicle Excise Commitments
overview: The Board approved motor vehicle excise commitments for late 2022 and early 2023, totaling over $5.1 million. These approvals authorize the collector to begin issuing tax bills for the accounts specified.

items.title: Motor Vehicle Excise Commitment 2022 #7
items.summary: The Board approved commitment number seven for 2022, covering 990 accounts for a total of $38,737.24.

items.title: Motor Vehicle Excise Commitment 2023 #1
items.summary: The Board approved the first commitment for 2023, totaling $5,094,859.27 across 37,525 accounts.
